plainText:
Sandstorm (Japanese: VS キリキザン VS Bisharp), titled VS Bisharp in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 481st chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 21st chapter of the .

It is subtitled Bisharp (Japanese: 砂漠 Desert) in the VIZ Media translation and Sandstorm in the Shogakukan Asia translation.

==Plot==
 
 and arrive on after finding their next target is Nimbasa City. However, a hinders their progress, and as White runs off to go buy sandstorm gear, Black sits at the library to study for his next Gym battle. He quickly runs into a group of s taking a break, playing a game of card flip organized by a mysterious man. After the game is concluded, Black speaks with the man, who takes him outside to introduce a new game to him; the man has his cut a line in the sand near a , then asks Black to guess which side of the line Drilbur will pop out of next. 

As the two play the game for several rounds, a Worker suddenly falls into one of Drilbur's holes. Black tries to help the Worker, but the man holds him back, pointing out that he had chosen this particular area to play the game because he had known the Workers had no business there. This leads him to declare that the Worker who fell is an imposter. 

The fake Worker sends a to fight the man's Bisharp, but it is defeated. Bisharp then cuts through the fake Worker's disguise, revealing him to be a . This leads Black to realize the mysterious man had purposefully set up the game to find the intruder, and he determines his identity is Grimsley of the Elite Four. Black asks him a series of questions, and Grimsley agrees to answer all of them if he is defeated in a Pokémon battle. Black is eager to accept the challenge, but soon discovers that if he loses, he will have to give up something highly valuable of his own. He realizes with anxiety that this could mean losing his Badges.
